metadata.title: [CHORE][UI]: Consistent ContextForge logo and branding assets
metadata.author: a-effort

description: ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes # [issue 2715](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/2715) --- ## 📝 Summary - Replace legacy logo.png and logo-small.png with new ContextForge SVG logos and icons across the app, docs, Helm chart, and templates - Add full set of branding assets to mcpgateway/static/ (horizontal/vertical logos in color/white/black, plus icons) as the single source of truth - Add complete Logos & Images table to the media kit with links to all hosted assets - Add docs-assets and docs-serve Makefile targets to sync logo SVGs from mcpgateway/static/ into docs at build time, avoiding file duplication - Update alt text across README, templates, and plugin docs for accessibility - Add unit tests validating that all expected logo assets exist Changes: - Branding assets: 7 new SVGs in mcpgateway/static/, removed old logo.png and banner PNG - Docs: Updated mkdocs.yml cover logo, replaced old theme logos, updated media kit - Templates: Updated admin.html, login.html, change-password-required.html to reference new logos - Build: Added docs-assets (syncs SVGs to docs), docs-serve (serves docs locally with asset sync and macOS DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH), .gitignore entry for generated copies - Tests: New tests/unit/test_logo_assets.py with 133 lines validating asset presence - Helm: Updated mcp-stack/Chart.yaml icon URL --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [ ] Bug fix - [] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [ ] Refactor - [x] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | | | Unit tests | `make test` | | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | | --- ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [x] Tests added/updated for changes - [x] Documentation updated (if applicable) - [x] No secrets or credentials committed --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) Added all logo/icon versions to the media kit. We can consider a more limited set / adding guidance later as a next step. For now, people would have a variety of updated options to choose from. Updated logo: note ^ spotting another instance of "MCP gateway" content to update as a follow up to: https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/2714

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
## Review

Clean PR — replaces legacy PNGs with new SVG branding assets, updates docs/templates/Helm references, and adds 12 tests validating asset consistency.

**Checked:**
- All 7 SVGs are clean (no scripts, event handlers, or embedded content)
- Template references (`admin.html`, `login.html`, `change-password-required.html`) are consistent with files on disk
- Docs theme logo, MkDocs cover logo, and README banner all resolve correctly
- `.gitignore` correctly excludes generated SVG copies while keeping committed PNG
- `docs-assets` / `docs-serve` Makefile targets work as expected
- Middleware test updates (`/static/logo.png` → `/static/admin.css`) are correct
- No stale references to removed `logo.png`, `logo-small.png`, or `contextforge-banner.png`
- Alt text improvements across templates and plugin docs are good accessibility fixes
- All 12 logo asset tests pass

**One fix applied:**
- Helm chart icon changed from `contextforge-icon_white.svg` (invisible on light backgrounds) to `contextforge-icon_black.svg` for universal visibility across Helm registries.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: LGTM — branding assets are clean, references are consistent, tests cover the key invariants.
